title: In Egypt, Guterres warns against Iran-US escalation
keyFacts: UN Secretary-General António Guterres called for dialogue and diplomacy to end the war between Iran and the United States in remarks on Monday to journalists in Cairo, Egypt.

title: Ebola: UN officials condemn killing of nurse in DR Congo
keyFacts: The UN’s Ebola coordinator and the head of the World Health Organization (WHO) have deplored the killing of a nurse working to halt the spread of the disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).

title: Why do planes keep circling before landing? UN has a plan to fix it
keyFacts: Air traffic delays cost billions and turn journeys into ordeals. Some countries are already proving that better coordination saves thousands of flying hours and cuts emissions – and the UN’s aviation agency wants the rest of the world to follow.
